what: The sage 16-step floor at the turbo rung's second seed (730451894), so every pair at that seed is same-seed and same-regime. Same graph as the ladder's sage rows (workflows/bench/h3_text_to_video_stamped_api.json), same five scenes, 1344x768, 345 frames.

scenes.standoff: t2va_frontier_standoff -- see bench/ladder_arms.json for what each scene tests
scenes.diner: t2va_diner_breakup -- see bench/ladder_arms.json for what each scene tests
scenes.opera: t2va_opera_grand_stage -- see bench/ladder_arms.json for what each scene tests
scenes.stairwell: t2va_stairwell_dialogue -- see bench/ladder_arms.json for what each scene tests
scenes.subway: t2va_subway_chase -- see bench/ladder_arms.json for what each scene tests

prompts: named by bank id through the runner's @bank: value; the text lives only in prompt_bank/
run: run_graph_arms.py --manifest bench/turbo_rung_floor_arms.json --runs 1 --seed 730451894 --hold-seed --no-alternate --out bench/results/2026-09-05_turbo_rung_floor_s2.jsonl (no warmup: the turbo runs before it warmed the server)
requires: a ComfyUI server up with this pack's graphs regenerated against the live /object_info; the larryvrh node pack loaded (MiniMaxH3TurboLoRA and MiniMaxH3TurboSampler in /object_info); the two LoRA files under models/loras/h3; the server unarmed (no H3_* keys but the capture root).
policy: sage always on (owner decision 2026-09-04); both arms rendered under sage alone so Sol is not in the comparison. Two seeds allowed again (owner decision 2026-09-05 evening).
